summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Lloyds Banking Group plc reporting a routine PDMR share sale by Group COO Ron van Kemenade, who sold 978,309 shares at an average price of ~105.43 pence per share on June 18, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transactional catalyst. It is merely a standard foreign private issuer current report on a managerial share disposal, with no board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics. The filing is equivalent to a routine insider trading notice. No special-situation classification applies.
